lines.l: We are prophecy born inside of me at the highest peak
Sacred energy take control of me rising from the deep
Through the dark in my lungs, seek the energy on the tip of my tongue like a prophecy
Floating into my blood, take my memory, take my memory
Into the night, in my lungs, seek the energy on the tip of my tongue like a prophecy
Floating into my blood, take my memory, take my memory
